items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Did you read Oscar Peterson’s biography [The Will to Swing] that Gene Lees wrote? You remember that scene when Ray Brown and Herb Ellis dyed their hair to each other's color and Oscar Peterson would never acknowledge that he noticed it.

ctx.x: Sort of a little like that, did you read the – well I won't mention that on this tape ‘cause it’s really not germane. Did you read Oscar Peterson’s biography [The Will to Swing] that Gene Lees wrote?
